title: "unplace-contigs"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
genome.path <- '~/project_data/downy/hifiasm/fcs-gx/kraken2/purge_dups/rag_tag'
genome.files <- list.files(genome.path, pattern = '.fasta.gz', full.names = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(genome.path, 'unplaced-contigs'), showWarnings = FALSE)
genomes <- list()
for (file in genome.files) {
  genome <- readDNAStringSet(file)
  unplaced.congtigs <- genome |> names() |> str_subset('RagTag', negate = T)
  writeXStringSet(genome[unplaced.congtigs], file.path(genomes.path, 'unplaced-contigs', str_remove(basename(file), '.gz')))
}
```


# Unplaced contigs

```{r}
blast.tb <- list.files(file.path(genomes.path, 'unplaced-contigs'), pattern = '.tsv', full.names = TRUE) |> 
  map_dfr(function(file) {
    read.table(file, colClasses = c('character')) |> mutate(sample = str_remove(basename(file), '.tsv'))
  })
blast <- data.frame(sample = blast.tb$sample,
                    seqid = blast.tb$V1,
                    length = blast.tb$V4,
                    e.value = blast.tb$V9,
                    name_or_id2df(blast.tb$V10,mode = 'id',fill_miss_rank = FALSE,add_prefix = FALSE) |> select(Phylum, Species))
blast |> 
  group_by(sample) |> 
  summarise(unplaced.hit=n()) |> 
  gt()

blast |> 
  group_by(sample, seqid) |> 
  gt() 
```
